metadata.title: Segment → Tealium Migration — Abercrombie & Fitch
metadata.description: How I led a $100k+ savings migration from Segment to Tealium for a global retail giant, reducing feature implementation time by 40% and delivering 2 months ahead of schedule.

blocks.title: Strategic Migration & Analytics Governance: Abercrombie & Fitch
blocks.challengeBody: As the Web Analytics Tech Lead, I was tasked with modernizing the tracking infrastructure for a global retail giant. The existing setup (Segment) was becoming cost-prohibitive due to data overages, and the decentralized nature of their code repositories led to fragmented data and slow deployment cycles for new marketing initiatives.

solutionItems.title: Accelerated Migration
solutionItems.description: Orchestrated the transition from Segment to Tealium. By prioritizing high-value event streams and mapping a clean transition logic, we cut the project timeline by 2 months.

solutionItems.title: Unified Tracking Architecture
solutionItems.description: Developed a standardized, "write-once-deploy-anywhere" tracking framework across multiple repositories. This involved creating custom TypeScript interfaces to ensure strict data-layer compliance across different product teams.

solutionItems.title: Automated Governance
solutionItems.description: To solve the "broken tag" problem, I engineered a schema validation layer. This framework acts as a pipeline blocker; if a developer pushes code that violates the tracking schema, the build fails, and a real-time alert is triggered.

solutionItems.title: AI-Enhanced Productivity
solutionItems.description: Integrated Agentic AI workflows into the development lifecycle to automate boilerplate tracking code and documentation, significantly reducing the "time-to-tag."

blocks.ahaBody: While auditing the checkout flow during the migration, we utilized Adobe Target and Tealium to identify a friction point in the mobile payment selector. By deploying a series of high-impact A/B tests, we validated that a simplified UI outperformed the legacy version, providing a clear data-backed mandate for the permanent UI change.

impactItems.label: Cost Efficiency — annual savings in licensing fees and data overage costs
Operational Velocity — reduction in feature implementation time through standardized framework
Conversion Lift — increase in checkout conversion rates via optimized A/B testing
Developer Output — increase in internal developer productivity through AI-assisted workflows
Leadership — developers guided to achieve full alignment with global marketing requirements
Delivery — ahead of the original project schedule
